page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 2 dedicated virtual CPUs, which map directly to 2 physical cores with 1 thread per core. The instance is configured with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through attached block storage volumes. It does not feature any GPU accelerators or complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The underlying CPU flags indicate a lack of advanced vector extensions, matrix extensions, or specialized hardware-accelerated cryptography instructions.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.s2.xlarge offers a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, making it a cost-efficient option for entry-level workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation without the overhead of complex instruction sets. Appropriate workloads include lightweight web serving, small-scale databases, development environments, and basic utility applications that do not rely on heavy parallel processing or hardware acceleration.
